Meeting row: Home → Dues → Record payment.
The three meeting moments from SCREEN-MAP: who owes, Bob handed me a check, show the report.
Open question 1: the pinned Record a payment button breaks v1's no-data-entry-on-Home rule. Keep, or leave it to the Dues tab only?
Open question 2: Owes is preselected whenever anyone owes. Alternative: always open on All with owing members sorted first.
Open question 3: Into account remembers the last payment's account (Cash box here). Nothing to type in the common case; date defaults to today.
Desk row: Ledger, Members, Reports. Bank import and the member detail screen are not drawn yet.
